designGaps: Four wizard steps have no dedicated main-app design screen: Tenants, Options, Lessor, Review/send; unit picker and draft-resume states also need explicit design extension.
Lease detail Payments and Activity tabs have no dedicated screen IDs; use existing implementation behavior and design their variants before styling.
ROI Benchmarks and Compare panels, benchmark editing and save dialog have no dedicated screen IDs; roi-scenarios is only partial coverage.
ROI chart subviews Cash Flow, Equity, Expenses, Amortization, Exit and Sensitivity require variant coverage beyond roi-projections.
Manager/public loading/error/not-found and operations/rent-analysis local boundaries lack dedicated matching screens; tenant-states is a reusable reference, not proof of complete manager design.

Property/unit add/edit/archive/delete controls, upload/preview/delete confirmations, payment/refund/expense/provider settings feedback are state-level design extensions; overview screens do not certify every form/error/dialog.
/ui showcase has no dedicated design; / is a redirect, not a new product screen.
Phone variants for most manager pages are absent as dedicated IDs; dashboard tablet/menu and analysis-phone do not cover every manager page.

Property/unit applications and maintenance reuse global screens with scoped chrome; no separate scoped IDs. Tenant empty/payment/repair/photo failure variants need state-specific coverage beyond tenant-states.

verification.mapChecks: JSON parse, route/boundary completeness, source existence, disjoint ownership, 40 app screen membership and diff whitespace checks required before submission.
verification.runtime: Not run: mapping-only task. Builders must run relevant listed checks and capture native desktop and 390px before/after for every changed route/state family, keyboard focus/dialog behavior, no overflow, chart/table amounts, scope/query and Back preservation. Use isolated fixtures for writes; do not infer live provider success.
verification.historical: docs/ux/full-app-review.md is retained context, not newly run evidence. Its submission identifiers are not Git SHAs; current admitted source membership was enumerated afresh.
verification.excludedRoutes: API, download/export, webhook/photo and submission route.ts handlers are action endpoints, not visual screens. Their user-facing success/error/loading feedback is included in consuming routes.
